key_points: Q2 revenue miss and weaker‑than‑expected Q3 guidance triggered an 8% after‑hours drop
Short‑term sell‑off evident across multiple media outlets
Viewership highs and bullish analyst notes are being outweighed by earnings disappointment
Institutional activity (Winton sell, Rep. Donalds purchase) adds mixed signals but limited impact
Historical pattern of large drops ending in higher highs is noted but not a near‑term catalyst
